source: REAL decoded Tekken 3 motion (owner's disc teardown)
root_t_note: Sampled at the 30fps clip grid. t3anims.js ignores root_t (game drives root.position).
stream_frames_note: Count of stored rot_xyzw frames at 30fps. The King bank's stream_frames counts the 60fps source motion stream (2x its stored rot frames); t3anims.js derives playback length from the rot arrays + fps, so both conventions play identically.
